LAST CALL 🕺 Happy Friday.  
The 2026 Black Fly Writers Retreat will be held from Thursday, April 30 through Sunday, May 3 at the Schoodic Institute ( in Winter Harbor, Maine. The Institute is inside Acadia National Park, and its campus is a National Park Service Research Learning Center. We are excited to be offering this writing retreat again at this location! [...] Black Fly Writers Retreat attendees will spend Friday, Saturday, and Sunday mornings (8:30 AM to 12 PM) in workshops of no more than ten participants working with one instructor. Afternoons will be open for writing and an optional small-group meetings with the instructor. There will be Thursday and Friday evening faculty readings and an optional Saturday evening open reading, giving attendees a chance to share their work with each other.   
This year’s instructors include Brandon Keim (nonfiction), Gretchen Legler (memoir), and Brock Clarke (fiction), left to right below.   
Workshop and registration details can be found on our website!
